maddeler.e:
اختطفن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَفْنَ (iḵtaṭafna) /ix.ta.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اُخْتُطِفْنَ (uḵtuṭifna) /ux.tu.tˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اِخْتَطِفْنَ (iḵtaṭifna) /ix.ta.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
